review_type: Visual inspection and consistency check against adopted scope and draft protocol; not human eligibility adjudication or scientific peer review.
inspection_method: Complete PNG viewed using view_image(detail=original); caption.md read in full.

checks.result: Readable at original resolution; no observed overlap, clipping, missing glyphs or crowded text collisions, including the context panel.
Date/status line and panel labels distinguish adopted scope from proposed empirical screening criteria; final eligibility is explicitly pending.
Separate awaiting-information panel states no automatic exclusion and prohibits inferring cisgender identity.
Exclusions match adopted population/indication scope. Figure and caption preserve separately extractable eligible findings and avoid blanket exclusion of all results in mixed reports.
Identity-assessment exemption is qualified as code-only findings; caption states that any patient-level component is assessed separately.

Empirical service valuation is distinct from patient evidence. Descriptive policy/code sources, clinical and other-payer evidence, physician-gender research and general implementation context are separated. Intervention context is qualified by absence of the required equity or need question.

Opposite-sex comparators are not mandatory and clinical need is assessed independently of coverage. Shared, reproductive-anatomy, reproductive-physiology and mixed/site-dependent categories remain distinct.
No selection counts, final eligibility decisions, new scope amendment or completed PRISMA review is asserted.
Caption is consistent with the figure and source criteria; it identifies research-scope decisions and pending reconciliation before publication.
